summary: Both blocking findings were defects of the running matter and both are repaired in the study's own sources. VIS-001: fancyhdr laps each head string out of a parbox the full width of the head, so the two occupy the same space and a long right string prints silently over the left one -- measured at minus 0.119 in of gutter on physical page 20 of the iteration-2 proof and 6 pt on page 26. format.tex now cuts the right head to what remains after the fixed left string and a 1.5 em gutter of real white space, so an overlong string wraps inside its own box instead of reaching its neighbour and trips fancyhdr's headheight warning, which the log carries; and the three interpretations, whose reader-first titles run to 67, 74 and 71 characters and are the only titles too wide for that box, declare the short running forms 'The Whole Heart and the One Body', "David's Son and David's Lord" and '"Thou Art Just, O Lord"' through a new \runninghead, while the headings and the contents keep the full titles. \runninghead had to set the mark and also replace the section's own: \rightmark takes the FIRST mark on a page, so a first attempt that wrote \markright after the heading left pages 20 and 26 exactly as they were. VIS-002: \section*{References} sets no mark, so the Appendix headed pages 36 and 37; the heading now calls \runninghead and both pages read References. It must stay starred -- an ordinary \section, tried and reverted, made check-content-preflight's references-used and unquoted-not-quoted report that the leaf prints no References section -- and the mark must go through \runninghead rather than the bare \markright the concise companion uses, because the web converter's macro whitelist does not carry \markright and this study is the leaf's only web edition. Advisory VIS-003 is cleared in passing: the Introit row of the opening map now prints the concise map's 'verse 1', taking its gutter to the third column from 6 pt to 33 pt, wider than any other row of that table. Advisory VIS-004 is deliberately not acted on, for the reason the finding itself records -- every repair it proposes moves the pagination of all 38 pages and unsettles this run's physical-marker evidence for a reader it states is not misled; the folio of every page is unchanged from iteration 2. The settled proof is build/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/57-seventeenth-after-pentecost.pdf, SHA-256 3fb87bf39141f9d5670add1fb1012f83196b6df398887c5f8435fc035fdee822, 38 physical pages, revision timestamp 2026-09-19T03:20:00Z, settling in two passes with two independent cold builds producing identical bytes and a log carrying no error, warning, overfull or underfull box, undefined reference or rerun request; all seven fonts embedded, subsetted and Unicode-mapped; 18,889 extracted words with no replacement character, 31 fewer than the 18,920 the same extraction gives the iteration-2 proof, and a word-frequency diff accounts for every one of them as running-head strings, the Introit reference and the timestamp, with no substantive word added or removed. Head geometry is measured, not asserted: every one of the 38 pages carries a single-line head, the narrowest gutter anywhere is 0.92 in on page 9, and pages 20 and 26 now stand at 2.35 in and 2.63 in. All seventeen checks pass at these bytes -- check-proper-components (artifacts/research), scripts/_proper_study.py check (content/research, --require-presentation), all thirteen check-content-preflight checks the study gate names including provenance-matches-run against this run's header, check-generation-metadata, check-web-edition, and a trial tools/web-edition conversion carrying the ten proper-<element-key> anchors. All 38 pages were rendered and both contact sheets read, with pages 3, 20, 26, 36 and 38 inspected individually: no blank or heading-only page, no clipping, collision or missing text. The terminal colophon page carries neither head nor folio, which is the shared \TriptychRightsNotice's own \thispagestyle{empty} and was the same at iteration 2, not a defect of this leaf. Both companions were rebuilt against the changed shared format.tex and are unchanged in extent, 12 and 5 pages, with clean logs and the concise opening still on its fixed physical pages. generation-metadata.tex carries the new shared timestamp and the iteration-3 contribution, and research/production-review.md records the repair, the two constraints that decided its form, and the proof. No research evidence was changed and no research defect was found; the workflow's shared-timestamp three-document build and independent visual review remain to be obtained.
